mapper.insert: INSERT INTO experience_route (street_area_id, name, theme, description, estimated_duration, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{streetAreaId}, #{name}, #{theme}, #{description}, #{estimatedDuration}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE experience_route SET street_area_id=#{streetAreaId}, name=#{name}, theme=#{theme}, description=#{description}, estimated_duration=#{estimatedDuration}, status=#{status}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, street_area_id, name, theme, description, estimated_duration, status, created_at, updated_at FROM experience_route WHERE id=#{id}
